Stone Projectile Points and Clay Pipe Fragments
17 Items, Mixed Age and Origin

The inclusion of early clay pipe fragments suggests a broad chronological range, potentially spanning from prehistoric indigenous cultures to historical-era trade goods.

Reeded Clay Pipe Bowl

4.
Clay Pipe Stem Fragment

Materials: Chert, flint, and fired clay

title: Vintage Wooden Tobacco Pipes Set Briar Wood Curved Stems Collectible

shipping.policy:
COMBINED SHIPPING - Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item. We will only combine up to 20lbs. We reserve the right to deny combined shipping when there is a probability for damage.
SHIPPING - All items ship via FedEx from our Indianapolis warehouse unless otherwise indicated in the item listing. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). We are unable to ship to APO or military addresses. Please allow 5 business days ( Monday-Friday) for your purchase to be shipped.
Please note: we no longer offer shipping to Canada.
THANK YOU for shopping with Goodwill of Central and Southern Indiana, we appreciate your business.

description: This listing features a set of three vintage wooden tobacco pipes, likely made of briar wood. Each pipe has a distinct curved stem crafted from different materials, including plastic and possibly Bakelite. The set includes one pipe with a decorative orange-toned mouthpiece, another with a light-colored section and a classic design, and a third with a rustic, carved appearance. All pipes show visible signs of use such as darkened bowls and some wear. Any condition issues are visible in the photos. These pipes are suitable for collectors of vintage smoking accessories and tobacciana. See photos for condition details.

description:
Alfco NY
Nautical Fisherman with Pipe
Hand Painted Composition / Resin
14.25" H x 5.5" W x 5.5" L
Unsigned (Stamped on base)
This vintage figurine by Alfco NY depicts a classic maritime character, a sea-weathered fisherman clad in a traditional yellow-orange slicker and sou'wester hat while smoking a pipe. The piece is crafted from a durable composition resin designed to emulate the texture and weight of a hand-carved wood sculpture, featuring deep, expressive graining and a warm, aged patina. The character's jovial expression and detailed attire make it a quintessential piece of mid-to-late 20th-century nautical decor.
Authentically marked with the " ALFCO-NY" stamp on the rear of the base
Detailed hand-painted finish highlights the weathered textures of the rain gear and facial features
Substantial 2.2-pound weight provides stability for display on shelves or mantels
Condition:
Good vintage condition. There is a prominent chip and material loss on the top of the hat as shown in photos. The remainder of the figure shows light surface wear and minor scuffing consistent with age. The base is stable and features a circular opening as manufactured.

All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight.
Shipping:
All items are typically shipped within five business days (Monday through Friday, excluding major holidays) following the date of purchase. We do NOT offer any shipping options faster than FedEx Ground.
Please contact us prior to making payment if there are specific shipping requirements or requests such as signature confirmation or insurance.
Additional charges may apply.
We do not, under any circumstances, accept pre-paid shipping labels provided by customers.
Please contact us with any questions or concerns regarding shipping prior to paying.
Combined Shipping:
Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item.
Local pickup
is available on
select items only
, and will be noted on the item as "Local Pickup". Pickup items are available at the Goodwill of Colorado Springs Main Campus, located at 1460 Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs, CO, 80907.
For qualifying pick-up orders, pickup is available by appointment only.
Delivery Not Received:
Please contact within 7 days of the expected delivery date if a package has not been delivered by the time provided by the shipping carrier. We will file a claim with the shipping carrier (typically FedEx) after that. Please do not file a claim before contacting us, FedEx requires the shipper to file them. If the item is returned to us because a signature could not be obtained, or if an item is returned to us as undeliverable/unclaimed it is the buyers responsibility to contact us within 7 days and pay the additional postage to mail it again otherwise items returned to us will be considered a donation and relisted at our discretion.
We are not responsible for packages that were delivered and stolen from property. Goodwill will not be liable and all refund requests will be denied.
Damaged Merchandise:
If merchandise has been damaged during shipping, please contact us within 7 days. Photos of packaging and item damages will be required for refund approval.

The stone's unique patterns are as individual as a fingerprint, ensuring your decor remains distinctive and sophisticated. Perfect for adding natural charm to contemporary interiors, this artwork is ready to hang and easy to incorporate into living rooms, bedrooms, offices, or entryways. The sturdy frame and clean matting offer lasting appeal and protection for the featured stone, while its versatile color palette complements a range of decor styles. Visible condition is very good, with minor signs of handling on the back and corner. See detailed images for closer inspection. This is a single piece, ideal as a statement accent or the start of a natural art collection.

Description:
Elevate your collection with this captivating white crystal geode slice, perfect for display or mineral enthusiasts. This specimen showcases an intricate crystalline formation radiating from a central opening, revealing striking transparency and natural geometric patterns. The rough exterior edge contrasts beautifully with the flat, polished face, enhancing the brilliance and depth of the crystals within. At approximately 7 inches across (as shown by the ruler), it offers substantial presence whether showcased on a shelf or used as a sophisticated accent piece. Its sturdy build and unique visual appeal make it ideal for collectors, educators, or anyone seeking natural beauty for their decor. The condition appears very good overall, with clean surfaces and only minor natural roughness on the edges. Please refer to photos for the exact condition and dimensions before purchasing.
